judgments.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a technical specification and tool for organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format, which is a general method, not a description of this specific dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: The paper introduces EEG-BIDS, an extension to BIDS, and references a series of public EEG datasets organized using this new standard, indicating it describes the data structure and associated data.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
